This folder is intended to contain a fork of the Nextcloud server repository (https://github.com/nextcloud/server).

Guidelines:
- Use this fork for local integration testing (WebDAV endpoints, auth flows) and keep modifications minimal.
- Prefer running Nextcloud in Docker for local testing rather than committing large server files.

License: Nextcloud server is licensed under AGPL or similar upstream; include the included license file in `vendor/nextcloud/LICENSE` as required.

See IMPORT.md for details about cloning and ZIP import instructions.
